description: This Java class 'WorkEffortKeywordIndex' is responsible for indexing keywords related to work effort entities in the OFBiz framework. It gathers data from various related entities, processes keywords with weights, and stores them for search optimization.

classes.name: WorkEffortKeywordIndex
classes.description: A utility class for indexing keywords associated with work effort entities for search purposes within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Indexes keywords for a given work effort entity, gathering related data, processing keywords with weights, and storing them.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Retrieves content text from a data resource, applies weighting, and adds it to the list of strings for indexing.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a string value from a specified field of a GenericValue to the list of strings, applying a weight based on configuration.
